'''Mikio Vadere''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]{{ref/book|twotc}}.

== Appearance and Personality ==
Mikio is 5'5" tall, and plump, with a round face, black hair worn short of her shoulders and dark brown eyes. Physically quite strong, she has a fairly ordinary appearance. 

Her eyes are the most striking thing about her; they are intent and inquisitive always; she has a way of noticing small things that escaped others’ notice. 

==Strength and Abilities==
Mikio is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to [[Traveling|Travel]].

== History ==
Mikio is 93 years old. She was born in {{ne|907}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|923}}. After spending twelve years as a [[novice]] and eleven years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the [[shawl]] in {{ne|946}}.

==Activities==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]] and was one of the [[ten ferrets]] sent to the [[White Tower]] to spread the rumour that the [[Red Ajah]] set [[Logain Ablar]] up as a [[False Dragon]].{{ref/book|7|8}}

When [[Zerah Dacan]] is found out to be a Salidar spy, she gives up Mikio's name as well. Mikio was so part of the group that was trying to hunt down the [[Black Ajah]]{{ref/book|8|26}}. When [[Meidani Eschede]] is freed from her oath of obedience, it can be assumed Mikio is as well.

==Trivia==
Mikio is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
